scenarios.note: A club with news, games, packages and a bar - the case that usually looks fine.
Nothing configured at all: no news, no games, no shop. Every slot shows its empty line.
More of everything than fits: 24 packages must scroll inside the till, the band shows four of many games.
Names as long as an operator can type them. Everything must clip or wrap, nothing may push its neighbour off the row.
No news: the hero rotates popular games. One executable becomes the play button.
A game with three executables and one of them running - all three launch buttons must sit on one row or wrap cleanly.
A game without a picture: the placeholder card, not a broken image.
No news and no games: goods are the last thing the hero falls back to.
Shop disabled for this host group: the till shows its two empty lines and nothing else moves.
Packages exist but none can be bought right now (availability window) while the bar is open.
A package sold for points only shows its points price on the row instead of a zero.

A club with the ladder on: the right column is two tiles (packages level with the hero, the loyalty summary level with the strip), the level ring on the avatar and the sign-in pill next to it. The short screen hides the next step.
The same with the top level secured: full ring, no points to keep.
The account page's Progress tab: the level card with the rail, the challenge cards, the achievement tiles, the last level change. Earning state, a reward waiting on one challenge.
The same tab with the top level secured.
A club with the ladder but no challenges or achievements: the level card and the history line alone.
A club with achievements and challenges but no ladder: no level card, no mark on the avatar; the sections start at the top.
No ladder: the summary's headline is the achievements (the ring their share), the challenges count on the caption, no bar, no mark on the avatar.
Only challenges: the headline is their count with the flag.
Deployment whose size is not known yet: the ring turns, no wash, no percentage.
The My applications panel over the home board: three rows, one of them deploying.
The My applications panel with nothing running: icon, title and hint centred.
Missed notifications counted on the bell: a disc for one digit.
Two digits widen the disc into a pill.
A game being deployed: the banner in the top bar must not push the icon pill off the bar.
The machine is reserved soon: the tile in the top bar's left track, the search yields room to it.
The whole board in the red palette: only the accent family changes, nothing else.
The whole board in the orange palette: only the accent family changes, nothing else.
The whole board in the amber palette: only the accent family changes, nothing else.
The whole board in the green palette: only the accent family changes, nothing else.
The whole board in the teal palette: only the accent family changes, nothing else.
The notification window's cards: one of each type and the reservation card with its buttons.
A title and a message as long as the server can send: they wrap, the card grows, the close button stays put.

items.title: Внимание: ваше игровое время на этом компьютере подходит к концу, и сессия будет завершена автоматически
items.message: Пополните счёт на стойке администратора или через приложение, либо возьмите пакет времени в магазине оболочки — иначе через несколько минут вы будете разлогинены, а несохранённый прогресс в играх может быть потерян.

scenarios.note: Sign-in screen at rest without a club wallpaper: the atmosphere, the aurora clouds at their first frame, the host number.
The same screen in the red palette: black and red, no magenta cloud.
The whole board in the purple palette (the former default; blue is the default now).
The whole board in the pink palette: only the accent family changes, nothing else.
The purchase card in another palette: the chooser, the button and the card's wash follow the accent.
Three goods in the cart, paid from the balance.
The cart costs more than the balance holds: top-up from the checkout, like the package.
One line paid with points (chosen on the cart page), the rest in money: both figures in the total.
Twelve lines with long names: the list scrolls, the chooser and the total stay put, the card fits a laptop panel.
Order paid from the balance.
The common case: enough money on the account, one way to pay.
Money short and online top-up available: the main button tops up by the difference.
Money short and no online top-up in this club: the button is dead and says why.
Paying with points: the points tile chosen, the total in points, points left afterwards.
Not enough points and no way to earn them here: the shortfall is stated, the button is dead.
Paid at the counter: the balance does not matter, the button places the order.
A club with every method enabled plus two of its own with long names: tiles wrap, names clip.
A promotion and a fee: the receipt lines must add up to the total shown.
Goods already in the cart are paid together with the package and are listed as a line.
A package the club gives away: no tiles, no method, a Get button.
The club offers no payment method to clients and the package has no points price: say so, disable.
A package name as long as an operator can type: two lines, then an ellipsis.

data.name: Ночной безлимит с пятницы на субботу для VIP-зала (только для зарегистрированных гостей клуба)
data.description: Ночной безлимит действует с 22:00 пятницы до 08:00 субботы на всех ПК VIP-зала. Пакет активируется при первом входе и не переносится на другой день. В стоимость включены два напитка на выбор из бара; оформить их можно у администратора при входе. При досрочном выходе неиспользованное время не возвращается.

The applications catalogue: the sorting caption, the three filters, three rows of eight posters.
A poster under the cursor: the category and the details button at the top, the three launch shortcuts over the dimmed cover.
Two filters set: the count chip, the tinted selects, the search-free caption.
A search with nothing found: the chip and the empty state.
The shop with every group: time plates, goods, bundles, two lines in the cart.

The links tab, one shortcut running, one deploying.
The sign-in card up: username, password, the status cluster and the host number.
Reservation notice above the card and a sign-in error inside it.
The top-up dialog: presets, the custom amount field, the summary.
The QR step with the two ways out.
The success state that closes itself.

Setting the PIN: the longer title and two buttons.

The global search dropdown over the board: goods with their group and the add-to-cart button. The middle column is the one that used to collapse to nothing when the button was long.
The profile card from the top bar: the orbit of icons, the name, the three actions.
The profile card in a club with the ladder on: the ring inside the avatar's rim, the level disc at its corner, one line under the name - here the reward to collect.
The profile card without a ladder: the ring is the share of achievements, the trophy disc, the count in the line.
The notifications list with three cards and the clear action.
